title: Transport Response Schema Migration 1048 Governed Rollout

phases.objective: Validate the repository-governed readiness, trusted evidence publication, exactly-once apply, and readback control plane for Migration 1048 without executing SQL, reading secrets, or mutating Production during CI.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The exact pull-request head contains the Migration 1048 rollout runner, read-only issue-comment producer, trusted workflow-run readiness publisher, regression test, and this phase contract.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The control plane proves checksum/blob-bound readiness, trusted publication of the exact readiness marker, explicit authorization, exactly-once Apply semantics with no retry, and verification by ledger/readback while CI itself performs no migration or external runtime mutation.
steps: Read the Migration 1048 governed rollout runner, producer workflow, trusted readiness publisher workflow, and publisher module from the exact pull-request head.
Verify that Issue-level workflow trigger commands remain control-plane commands while runtime authorization and Apply typed confirmations are derived from the exact canonical migration filename.
Verify that the issue-comment rollout producer has no GitHub metadata write permission and only uploads checksum-bound readiness evidence.

Verify that the trusted workflow-run publisher accepts only a successful exact source run, validates the readiness artifact and marker fields, deduplicates an identical marker, and writes only the bound marker to Issue #6531.

Execute the repository regression that checks command bindings, Production provenance guards, dry-run gating, canonical runtime typed confirmations, trusted readiness handoff, single Apply dispatch, no retry behavior, and Verify-only reconciliation.

Record repository evidence only; do not execute Migration 1048, connect to a live database for mutation, read credentials or secrets, call a provider, deploy, mutate Production, or publish a real readiness marker during CI.
assertions: Readiness is bound to the live Production SHA, Migration 1048 path, expected blob SHA, exact checksum, and statement count before Apply can become eligible.
The authorization bootstrap confirmation is derived as AUTHORIZE_GOVERNED_MIGRATION_<canonical migration filename without .sql> rather than reusing the Issue trigger command.
The governed executor Apply confirmation is derived as APPLY_<canonical migration filename without .sql> and therefore preserves the complete transport_response_chunk_schema_recovery identity.

The issue-comment rollout producer remains read-only to GitHub repository metadata; readiness publication is isolated behind a trusted workflow_run publisher consuming the exact successful source-run artifact.

The readiness publisher validates source workflow identity, source head SHA, result=ready_for_apply, secrets_included=false, Production SHA, migration blob, checksum, statement count, authorization=pass, and dry_run=pass before writing the marker to Issue #6531.
Apply requires explicit checksum-bound readiness evidence and contains exactly one governed migration execution path with no automatic retry.
Verify performs ledger/readback reconciliation without sending Apply.
CI performs no SQL mutation, migration Apply, provider call, credential or secret access, deployment, Production mutation, external send, or force update.
